Dear Dr. Alvarez,

Thank you for your continued partnership with the Houston Independent School District. This letterhead template demonstrates the correct placement of the brand ribbon, the district logo, and the running header and footer that repeat on every printed page. The body type uses the brand sans-serif with an Arial fallback so the document reproduces cleanly even where the brand fonts are not installed.

Widow and orphan control is enabled throughout, so paragraphs that span a page break will not leave a single dangling line stranded at the top or bottom of a page. Brand fills such as the ribbon are set with print-color-adjust: exact, which forces the teal band to print rather than being dropped by the browser's default ink-saving behavior.

To reproduce this letter for a professional print run, supply your printer with the Pantone and CMYK builds in color-reference.md — not the on-screen hex values. Teal is PMS 7467 C / CMYK 78 15 31 0.

Please reach out to the Office of Communications with any questions about applying the HISD brand to district correspondence.

Sincerely,


Alejandro Banegas
Creative Director, Houston Independent School District

Screen preview only. To produce a PDF: open in Chrome → Cmd-P (Ctrl-P) → "Save as PDF", paper US Letter, margins "Default", and enable "Background graphics" so the teal ribbon prints.
